A long-form report (February 2025) on the same killing: six months on, no suspects charged; the police classified it a "culpable homicide" and misgendered the body; nearly 6,000 signatures on a petition asking for hate-crime categorisation, met with misgendering abuse online; context on the 2014 same-sex-marriage prohibition law (up to 14 years; bans marriages, organisations and public promotion; historic "carnal knowledge" laws remain), the separate religious-law death-penalty regime elsewhere in the country, no legal gender change, and hormone therapy obtained through online international pharmacies without medical guidance.
